In my opinion, what you actually need there is a version control repository, where you can adapt your method to be 'commit often'. This then lets you restore or export any previous revision of whatever set of files you were versioning. I'm a fan of Mercurial (see the TortoiseHg client), though any such program (Subversion, Git) should be fine. Incidentally, repos are also great for backing up your game saves with useful commit notes about what you were doing at the time (such as just prior to adding new mods).

There's a slight learning curve on using them in general. If you have access to a server on the internet then, with a bit of initial setup, I'd also encourage synching your stuff to that over SSH.
